versions.changelog:
- Renamed skill from "tripseek" to "ctrip" for clarity.
- Updated description to emphasize planning trips to China.
- No functional changes; core capabilities and usage examples remain the same.

Initial release of tripseek: an all-in-one travel management skill.

- Supports international trip planning and multi-destination itineraries.
- Manages family travel logistics and age-specific needs.
- Optimizes travel costs and routes.
- Handles travel document preparation and booking coordination.
- Provides references for flights, hotels, attractions, documents, and more.
